items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And, of course, Norman was the bass player. I think he's out in Frisco now... Fred Norman was a trombone player with Tommy Miles, too. He was in Tommy Miles' band even before Trummy Young

ctx.x: And the trombone player, we called him Mushmouth. I forget his real name. And the trombone player was a beautiful trombone player. And, of course, Norman was the bass player. I think he's out in Frisco now.
No, not Norman. He was a football player. He lives in San Francisco. He --
